thesis: Revenue and diluted EPS each rose about 11% year over year, and cash exceeds debt. That combination supports a modest simulated entry at the supplied close of 100, which is 20 times reported diluted EPS.
uncertainty: Both records are synthetic and their origins are unauthenticated. One year of growth leaves its durability uncertain, and the excerpt provides no cash-flow or peer valuation data.
allocation_reasoning: At the cited price of 100, 100 shares plus the 1 fill fee put 10001 against the 25000 position limit and leave 89999 in cash, above the 20000 minimum. The position uses about 10% of the starting book because the thesis rests on a single annual comparison.

exit_conditions.text: Exit the simulated position if a subsequent comparable filing reports a year-over-year decline in revenue or diluted EPS, or if debt exceeds cash.
